title: A digestive fluid is produced
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The liver produces bile, which can be stored and concentrated in the gallbladder before delivery to the duodenum.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which organ produces bile for delivery to the small intestine? The liver produces bile, which can be stored and concentrated in the gallbladder before delivery to the duodenum.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
